fields.situation: Mr. Delgado in 4 West bed 12 has become hypotensive and confused in the last hour.
fields.background: Admitted two days ago after bowel surgery; on piperacillin-tazobactam; creatinine 1.9, lactate 4.8.
fields.assessment: BP 82/50, HR 124, RR 26, SpO2 91 percent on 2 L, temperature 38.9 C. I think he is septic and getting worse.
fields.recommendation: Please come to the bedside within 15 minutes; I am calling rapid response now and request fluids and cultures.
fields.readBack: Hypotensive, confused, lactate 4.8; I will come now and order a fluid bolus and cultures.
